findings: Tool training is instance state, separate from refinement and socket stones.
Axe/shears are recognized by current runtime IDs although their prototypes are weapons. Combat/appearance semantics still require review before conversion.
Rod families contain self-refinement links. No automatic published recipes are emitted.
world/fishing.cpp defines ENABLE_FISHINGROD_RENEWAL locally; ActivitySystem.cpp tests that macro in a different translation unit. Exact production preprocessing remains a conversion gate.
Fish processing/grilling currently depends on fishing.json plus vnum arithmetic; native rows use explicit target ItemKeys.
Campfire spawn behavior and legacy ITEM_TOOL noop dispatch are not supplied by this ordinary gathering implementation.
scope: Offline source audit, not an installable conversion.
